def load_data():

    for img_id in train_df["image_id"].values:

        if os.path.exists(path):
            train_images.append(path)

    train_ids = train_df["image_id"].values

    return train_df, test_df, train_ids, train_images


class LeafDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, image_paths, targets, transform=None):
        self.image_paths = image_paths
        self.targets = targets
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.image_paths)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img = Image.open(self.image_paths[idx]).convert("RGB")
        if self.transform:
            img = self.transform(img)
        targets = self.targets[idx]
        return img, targets


def get_transforms(train=True):
    if train:
        transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.RandomResizedCrop(224),
                transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                transforms.ColorJitter(
                    brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2, hue=0.1
                ),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )
    else:
        transform = transforms.Compose(
            [
                transforms.Resize(256),
                transforms.CenterCrop(224),
                transforms.ToTensor(),
                transforms.Normalize(
                    mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]
                ),
            ]
        )
    return transform

    classes = ["healthy", "rust", "scab", "multiple_diseases"]

    transform = get_transforms(train=True)
    X_train = {}

        dataset = LeafDataset(train_images, targets[col], transform)

        X_train[col] = None
        y_train[col] = targets[col]

        X_train[col] = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(*dataloader)

            torch.nn.ReLU(),
